template.title: 1. Download the template
template.explanation: Fill in the template with one student per row, then upload it below. Keep the first row of headers exactly as it is. Row 2 is a filled-in example — delete it before you upload, or that student will be imported too.

columns.student_name: The student's full name, e.g. আরিফা খাতুন.
columns.class: A class name that already exists for the current academic year, e.g. Class 5.
columns.section: A section of that class, e.g. A.
columns.roll: A whole number, unique within the class section. Leave empty to skip.
columns.registration_number: Ignored — registration numbers are generated by the system.
columns.guardian1_phone: A Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. 01712345678 or +8801712345678.
columns.guardian1_email: An email address. Leave empty to skip.
columns.guardian2_name: A second guardian's name. Leave empty if there is only one guardian.
columns.guardian2_phone: Required when guardian 2 has a name. Same phone format as guardian 1.
columns.guardian2_email: An email address for guardian 2. Leave empty to skip.
columns.home_address: The student's home address. Leave empty to skip.
columns.preferred_communication: One of SMS, WHATSAPP, EMAIL, PHONE_CALL, MESSENGER. Leave empty to skip.

upload.title: 2. Upload your file
upload.explanation: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB and 2,000 students per file.

result.title: 3. Result
result.partialSummary: {{success}} of {{total}} students imported. {{errors}} rows had problems.
